title: João Moutinho represents BUILT CoLAB at the International Conference “Green and Digital Transition in the Recovery Plans”
excerpt: BUILT CoLAB will be represented by João Moutinho, Business and Internationalisation Director, at the international conference “Green and Digital Transition in the Recovery Plans: The sovereignty of technology and innovation”, organised by ANI, in collaboration with the European Association of Research&Technology Organisations (EARTO), taking place on 26 April.…
content:
BUILT CoLAB will be represented by João Moutinho, Business and Internationalisation Director, at the international conference “Green and Digital Transition in the Recovery Plans: The sovereignty of technology and innovation”, organised by ANI, in collaboration with the European Association of Research&Technology Organisations (EARTO), taking place on 26 April.

João Moutinho is one of the guest speakers on the panel “Key technologies for Green and Digital Transition: some cross sectoral examples”. The Digital and Climate Transition is, in fact, the core theme of BUILT CoLAB's mission, with regard to the built environment and within the scope of the AEC sector.

During the event there will be two further topics under discussion: the first panel will highlight RTOs (Research&Technology Organisations) as generators of synergies within the scope of recovery instruments; and the second panel will centre the discussion on the importance of the ecological and digital transition for the development of regional and national technological capabilities.

This international conference is held under the Portuguese Presidency of the Council of the European Union and aims to discuss the ecological and digital transition in the context of recovery plans, focusing on the role of technology and innovation in developing and promoting regional, national and European technological capabilities. Collaborative Laboratories (CoLABs), entities monitored by ANI, such as BUILT CoLAB, will be in the spotlight at this event given their relevance to the green and digital transition.

To find out more about the event see here. Registration is free, but required, here.
